lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Addressed the round-1 reviewer WARNING on US-002/US-003 (patterns.md Doc Maintenance gap): after US-002 raised the idle-gate's default idleTimeoutMs from an inline 5_000 ms to the exported IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS constant (30_000 ms), three prose spots still claimed the idle-gate 'polls the full 5s idleTimeoutMs budget' -- now false and actively misleading (an unprimed pane now blocks 30s, not 5s). Fixed all three in this commit: (1) scripts/cam/patterns.md:646 (the CAM-200 makeNotifyOrchestrator bullet's 'Real-tmux test fixture gotcha' paragraph) now names IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS (30 000 ms) instead of '5s idleTimeoutMs', and reworded the trailing 'still well under the 5s per-test timeout' clause (which was backwards post-raise) to correctly attribute the fast wall-clock to the priming fix rather than to the deadline being small; (2) test/integration/review-verdict-handback.test.ts:56-58 (primeIdlePrompt jsdoc) and :101-104 (test body comment) both updated from '5s idleTimeoutMs' to 'IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS (30 000 ms)'. Pure comment/doc changes, zero production or test-assertion code touched. Comment edits added one line to test/integration/review-verdict-handback.test.ts (171->173, gate's content.split('\n').length measure), so raised its file-size ceiling with a dated _ref entry naming US-R1-002/CAM-358, staged before re-running the gate. Full bun run check:all spine (typecheck, test [5148 pass, 0 fail], embed-vendor n/a [no vendor/templates touched], lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps) passed green after the ceiling raise. No further round-1 reviewer findings remain outstanding in prd.json as of this handoff.
